resources.string: In Requester mode, find a trip from Home and open it to see the store, shopping time and handoff point. In Commando mode, publish your own trip from Home.

Open a trip, choose products, then review the quantities and commission before placing your order. Open Order history in Profile to see your orders. In this version, orders are kept during your signed-in session.
The order review shows estimated product prices and the commission. In-app payments are not available in this version.
You can change or remove items before placing an order. Cancelling a placed order is not available in this version.
How do I contact another student?
Direct messaging is not available in this version. You can find the handoff point in the trip details. For help with the app, contact the support email address below.
